background_setting: A narrow two-way city street in a dense urban neighborhood during clear midday. Multi-story brick and rendered facades line both sides, with ground-floor shopfronts, awnings, and residential windows. Cars are parked along both curbs, leaving a tight single-file drivable corridor. A faded center line separates the two directions of travel. Sidewalks hold a few pedestrians, streetlamps, and small trees. The oncoming lane ahead is empty, offering room to slip past the obstruction.

actions.description: The ego car travels forward down the narrow street and detects the white delivery van double-parked ahead with hazard lights flashing; it begins to slow. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego continues decelerating and initiates a left steering input, checking the empty oncoming lane for a gap. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle steers left into the oncoming lane, passes alongside the double-parked van, and begins straightening back toward its lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view moves forward down a narrow two-way city street lined with parked cars under bright midday sun with sharp shadows. By 0:01 a white delivery van appears double-parked in the ego lane ahead, its amber hazard lights flashing at all four corners, and the ego car begins to slow. At 0:02 deceleration continues and the viewpoint begins angling left, glancing into the empty oncoming lane. From 0:03 the ego steers into the oncoming lane and eases alongside the van, the vehicle sliding to the right of frame. Through 0:04 and 0:05 the ego passes the van completely and begins straightening back toward its lane, the street opening up ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Low continuous engine hum and tire-on-asphalt rolling noise, briefly rising then dropping as the car decelerates. Faint rhythmic clicking suggestive of the van's hazard flashers, distant city ambience with muffled traffic and occasional pedestrian sounds. No speech or music.
